messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — dedicated GPU pool (us-west-2, reserved) saturated. Affected tenants: AcmeCorp (enterprise) showing increased 429s and request queue growth. Autocaler alerts: scale_attempts failing with quota/alloc errors. Oncall: @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: I’m on it. first check: is this noisy-tenant eviction or autoscaler failing to create nodes?
maria: seeing large tail of queued requests on pool:reserved-usw2. avg queue_len 180 -> 450 in last 12m. latency p50->p95 120ms->2.1s. AcmeCorp requests experiencing 429s.
kevin: autoscaler logs show repeated create failures: API quota error 403 "Exceeded gpu quota" from cloud provider. scale_attempts backoff in loop.
ops-oncall: ok that explains failures. any evidence of noisy neighbor hogging GPU slots?
sam: metrics show a few non-reserved orgs with long running sessions (batch jobs) occupying 8/12 nodes. eviction policy currently disabled for reserved fairness during business hours.
lia: propose two immediate mitigations: 1) enable preemptive eviction for non-enterprise sessions, 2) re-route AcmeCorp to their dedicated fallback pool (if available) or lower-capacity model variant while we restore capacity.
maria: can we enable burst emergency capacity (burst-reserve) for AcmeCorp? product said there’s a small burst reserve but needs manual toggle.
ops-oncall: I’m toggling eviction now: `kubectl annotate pool reserved-usw2 eviction=enabled --overwrite` — rolling evictions started. also opening customer bridge with AcmeCorp.
incident-bot: Action recorded by ops-oncall: annotated pool reserved-usw2 eviction=enabled.
kevin: autoscaler still failing to create because cloud project GPU quota is at account-level hard limit. I’ve opened quota request with provider but not instantaneous. we need local workarounds.
sam: started draining non-enterprise pods with label `batch:long` and bumped requeue priority for enterprise sessions. firing `kubectl drain --selector=batch=long --grace-period=30` on three nodes.
lia: routing change applied to redirect AcmeCorp traffic to fallback model: `route set acmecorp -> model-small-v2` (will degrade quality but reduce GPU footprint).
ops-oncall: confirming telemetry: AcmeCorp 429s down 85% after routing and evictions. queue_len now 120 -> trending down. still watching. customer bridge in progress with support.
maria: opening follow-up: need post-incident action items: request quota increase, add autoscaler retry/backoff alert, enforce per-tenant session limits to prevent long-running batch from saturating reserved pools.
kevin: note: autoscaler should surface quota error as critical and trigger fallback to on-host batching, not just retry. filing ticket now.
ops-oncall: handing off to morning SRE rotation for cleanup and quota escalation. I’ll leave bridge with AcmeCorp and a short summary. thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident annotated: status=mitigated, summary="reserved-usw2 saturated -> evictions + routing reduced customer impact". bridge duration ~28m.
